why: Doc sentence is VERBATIM (typescript.md:1319); the rest of that line ('Read this field to surface the request in your own UI, then resume with the same session_id to continue') supports rather than reverses it, and the SDK halves exist in 0.3.183 (sdk.d.ts:779 HookPermissionDecision includes 'defer'; :3880 deferred_tool_use). The absence in our Claude backend is real (grep -a over packages/shared/src/agent/backend/claude/ + claude-agent.ts = 0 hits; positive control: the same grep -a returns 3 hits in pi-agent.ts). But the finding is refuted on three independent grounds. (1) RECORDED OWNER DECISION, not a defect. The parity audit's runtime-scope directive, 'decided with the user 2026-07-26' (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-25-nessy-claude-parity-audit.md:237-258), states: 'A Claude-runtime-only gap is parked - not deleted, because the flags can flip, but not planned ahead of Pi-facing work' and 'Where a row has a Pi half and a Claude half, the Pi half is the priority', with :233-235 explicit: 'Deviations already recorded as Claude- or Codex-only carry that scope; do not spend a unit on them.' NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE defaults OFF (AGENTS.md). Defer landed on Pi under plan 2026-07-28-durable-approvals-and-questions.md Task 5, whose stated scope is 'the headless surface' / 'the headless runner (packages/server)'; parity audit row R7 closed on that scope. Sibling Claude-only gaps are already parked with the same reason (R13 file checkpoints :706; 'Bash isolation on the Claude backend' :753; the managed-filter bound :227-232). (2) WRONG SEAM CITED. claude-agent.ts:1428-1434 does NOT contain the allow/modify/block/ask switch - those lines are the additionalContext assembly and the continueWith() helper; the switch is at :1450-1468. More importantly that switch is on checkResult.type, the internal runPreToolUseChecks permission result, whose union has no 'defer' arm on EITHER backend: Pi handles defer at the hook-decision layer (pi-agent.ts:3872, 'hookDecision?.decision === defer'), never at runPreToolUseChecks. So 'the PreToolUse translation switch handles allow/modify/block/ask and never emits permissionDecision defer' mis-names the mechanism - the actual Claude-side drop point is runClaudePreToolUseHookPipeline (claude-agent.ts:156-179), which at :177 keeps only 'ask'/'allow' and therefore silently discards a 'defer' decision, degrading it to the normal flow exactly as Pi's own interactive/multi-call branches do. (3) THE SECOND HALF'S CONSEQUENCE IS INERT BY CONSTRUCTION. mergeClaudeSdkHooks (claude-agent.ts:125, guard at :133 'if (sourceIndex === 1 && event === PreToolUse) continue') drops every trusted PreToolUse matcher so our internal callback is the ONLY SDK PreToolUse hook, and it never returns permissionDecision 'defer'. The SDK therefore cannot produce a stop_reason 'tool_deferred' result in this fork, so 'the result adapter never reads msg.deferred_tool_use' (event-adapter.ts:578-585, terminalReason derived from stop_reason==='refusal' or the error subtype) describes an unread field on a message that cannot arrive - a dead-field observation, not a live bug. No hit in the inert-worklist section 3 (its only 'defer' row is the unrelated ManagedDeliveryStateV1 outcome:'deferred'), and no deviation-register row - because the scope is carried by the audit directive above instead.
correctedState: Defer is implemented on the shipped Pi runtime only: pi-agent.ts:3872 honours a PreToolUse hook decision of 'defer' on headless single-tool-call turns, emitting complete{terminalReason:'tool_deferred', deferredToolUse}, with tool_deferred_unavailable on resume (pi-agent.ts:4695-4700) and forwarding through SessionManager.ts:18328 and dto.ts:357. On the flag-off Claude backend (NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE defaults off) neither half exists: runClaudePreToolUseHookPipeline (claude-agent.ts:156-179) narrows the hook decision to 'ask'|'allow' at :177 so a 'defer' is silently dropped and the call falls through the normal permission flow - the allow/modify/block/ask switch at claude-agent.ts:1450 is a different layer (the runPreToolUseChecks result, which has no 'defer' arm on Pi either) - and the result adapter (backend/claude/event-adapter.ts:578-585) reads neither deferred_tool_use nor terminal_reason. The adapter half has no reachable consequence today because mergeClaudeSdkHooks:133 strips all trusted SDK PreToolUse matchers, leaving our own callback as the only PreToolUse hook the SDK sees, so no tool_deferred result can ever be produced. This is a Claude-runtime-only gap and is therefore PARKED per the owner directive at parity-audit:237-258, not an open defect.
